name: Rain98
source:
Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3498720/Rain98/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1998年，东京。一场永不停歇的连绵阴雨，与一名渴望让一切就此终结的少女。两个孤独的年轻人，将用他们的选择改变世界。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3498720/Rain98/]Steam[/url]]
